display_information.name: HuddlePace
display_information.description: Slack-native meeting timekeeper and speaker copilot to prevent meeting drift
display_information.long_description:
HuddlePace is a Slack-native meeting timekeeper and speaker companion designed to keep teams focused and meetings on schedule.

Meet Vector, your pacing companion: a focused flight navigator that tracks your agenda directly inside Slack Huddle threads without audio interruptions.

Key Capabilities:
• Modular Timeboxing: Structure meeting agendas into defined topics with percentage-based time budgets.
• Visual Progress Bars: Monospace progress meters and live countdown timers posted directly in the Huddle thread.
• Speaker Guidance: Private DM reminders at midpoint and wrap-up marks to maintain steady pacing without interrupting speakers.
• Role-Gated Controls: Interactive session actions reserved strictly for assigned speakers to prevent accidental disruptions.
• Instant Commands: Configure full agendas through interactive modals or trigger timed sessions on demand with /pace.
